reviews.title: Advertises no ads, lies!
reviews.text: Annoying ads. Lots of them

reviews.title: Yikes!
reviews.text: I’ve had this on my phone for several years and have thoroughly enjoyed solving the puzzles. Here the last 8 months or so it keeps lagging, taking forever to load, or just making my phone freeze up. I’ve uninstalled the app and reinstalled it but that didn’t help. I hope you can fix this issue because I do miss the puzzles.

reviews.title: Misled

reviews.title: Blocks Candy Crush
reviews.text:
This is the SECOND TIME that I came close to winning Candy Crush, when a CROSSWORD EXPLORER ad froze me out of my game.
😤

reviews.title: Won’t end a game
reviews.text: Multiple times I have gone in and double checked my answers and fixed any errors. However, the game won’t go to “won” until I spend 10 coins for 5 letters. I have screenshotted before I lose coins and after, and both puzzles are identical. Yet, you can see the score has gone down 7. (-10+3 for winning) Otherwise I would give it a 4. 🤷🏼‍♀️

reviews.title: Hate the one add
reviews.text:
. I have commented that the Kelshi ad is very offensive. There isn't a variety of ads so You have to sit there as long as it takes to get your coins. I didn't come to sit on a Kelshi as for five minutes just to get my bonus coins
I'll quit playing. Before I spend another five minutes sitting on an ad.

reviews.title: Ads need to play shorter
reviews.text: Ads play too long and are too difficult to close. I deleted the app for this reason! I realize ads are necessary for a free app, but when they are too annoying, it isn’t worth it!

reviews.text: So far so good! Tests my brain.

reviews.title: Delay response
reviews.text: It’s really too bad because I really like this crossword puzzle. But the delay each time you try to use. It is terrible.   You enter a few words, and then it gets stuck.   Now for two days I’ve tried to boot it up and it just freezes. It doesn’t go any further than the first screen.    I’ve tried to report this, but I can’t find anywhere to report it.

reviews.title: Can’t get out of the add
reviews.text: I’m trying to get out of the ad and go back to my game

reviews.title: Great Except….
reviews.text: Nice puzzles. I get that if you don’t pay you get ads, but sometimes you have to hit the X 5 or 6 times to get out of the same ad, plus the X is hidden many times or there appears no way out of the ad loop. This sours  what could be an entertaining session. My guess is they want the experience SO annoying that you just pay. I’m more inclined to just delete.

reviews.title: Too many ads

reviews.text: I purchased the ad free option but I still get ads. In fact I don’t see any difference. After playing a couple of games, you still have to watch an ad to continue. I wrote them and they stated it doesn’t remove all ads. I have requested a refund,  which I’m sure I won’t get. Don’t waste your money.
